flag_type_definitions.conflict: Two sources disagree on the same fact and both still stand. Stelco employment-undertaking compliance (union vs company) stays conflict.
flag_type_definitions.gap: A required field is missing (amount, jobs, date).
flag_type_definitions.follow_up: An open question for a later pass (FUP- id when minted).
flag_type_definitions.company_reported: The company is the source; treat as attributed, not independently confirmed.
flag_type_definitions.secondary_source: Coverage is not the primary record (news recap of a filing).
flag_type_definitions.ceiling_not_obligation: A contract ceiling is not money in hand.
flag_type_definitions.identity_unresolved: Legal entity or site is not matched (TCS Electronics vs E0027).
flag_type_definitions.research_only: Useful context that must not become a digest finding.
flag_type_definitions.not_wny_production: Not in-region production for the Western New York desk.
flag_type_definitions.correction: Later or more precise information replaces an earlier stated fact or its scope. Stelco export_decline_scope (58% is Canadian cold-rolled and coated steel to the US, not company-only or all steel) is correction, detail exports_scope — not conflict.
flag_type_definitions.update: New information adds to a still-valid earlier claim without saying it was wrong (further layoff counts on the same Stelco event).
flag_type_definitions.clarification: Wording or context restated; the numeric fact is unchanged.
flag_type_definitions.retraction: The original claim is withdrawn. Stronger than correction. Flags digest items that carried it (SI-026).
flag_type_definitions.unconfirmed: Attributed, not established. Use detail county for SI-003 multi-site county (Fathom Farmington / Ontario County). Not a finding-confidence word.
